path_basis: All report paths are relative to the Evidence directory that contains DRC, LVS and Simulation.
scope: This selected-results archive contains seven layout identities: two historical ADAPT DRC examples and five separate supplementary implementations.
identity_join_rule: Join reports by public_identity, not by design name. Same-design reports from different populations do not establish joint DRC/LVS/electrical qualification of one layout.
not_included: The later fixed six-layout matched ADAPT/baseline study is not represented by these records.

DRC_scope.limitations: Declared research polygon checks, not complete foundry device/process, density, antenna or coloring signoff. Runtime PROJECTING/PARALLEL warnings are retained in the reports.

ALIGN.scope: Recorded ALIGN mock-PDK selected-hierarchy checks and project qualification; not foundry signoff or device-level LVS.

unexpanded_input_source.scope: No original-source LVS result for this historical identity is provided by this archive.

records.identity_note: The supplementary DRC/LVS reports under the same design name concern a different implementation. They must not be combined with this ALIGN result to claim joint qualification.

LVS.source_reference_description: Constructed from input, compiled topology, generator rules and PDK; includes explicit edge-device groups and implemented geometric parameters; not the unexpanded original input source.

W_L_scope.W_definition: Planar channel-area/L probe width, including aggregate parallel width and edge groups; not calibrated FinFET electrical Weff.
W_L_scope.scope: Exact geometric L/W agreement with the declared generator reference after permitted comparison transformations; not electrical model calibration or equivalence to original long-channel parameters.
